lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.qi_guiding.desc: Sense ambient qi and guide it inward, unlocking basic manuals, journals and meditation cushions.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.circulation.desc: Complete meridian circulation to unlock seated meditation, route growth, built-in spell graphs and secondary manuals.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.body_tempering.de: Temper sinew and bone with qi, unlocking the body-tempering route and Marrow Pill.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.fetal_breath.desc: Sustain internal respiration through qi, unlocking the fetal-breath route and Breath Pill.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.bigu.desc: Nourish the body with ambient qi instead of grain, unlocking the bigu route and Fast Pill.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spirit_stones.des: Understand spirit stone matrices, crystal shards and dust, unlocking spirit stones and the Spirit Compass.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.qi_refining.desc: Condense a stable sea of qi, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 1 (Qi Refining).
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.foundation_buildi: Forge an unshakeable cultivation foundation, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 2 (Foundation Building).
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.golden_core.desc: Crystallize inner qi into a Golden Core, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 3 (Golden Core).
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.nascent_soul.desc: Awaken the Nascent Soul within the core, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 4 (Nascent Soul).
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spirit_transforma: harmonize spirit with heaven and earth, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 5 (Spirit Transformation).
Refine metals, glass and silk with qi to produce Spirit Iron Blanks, Ingots, Spirit Glass and Spirit Thread.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.pill_refining.des: Master furnace heat control and herbal blending, unlocking the Alchemy Furnace, Cinnabar Spirit Ink and pill refining.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.herb_tasting.desc: Identify herbal properties through qi perception and field tasting when formal Materia Medica is unavailable.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.restorative_pills: Refine spirit herbs and spring water into Qi Recovery Pills and Detox Pills.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.breakthrough_pill: Condense high-grade crystals and herbs at intense heat to refine Breakthrough Pills.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.herbal_formulas.d: Combine classical herbalism with pill alchemy to refine Nourish Qi, Calm Spirit, Clear Heat, Invigorate Blood and Resolve Toxin pills.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.talisman_basics.d: Prepare talisman paper, cinnabar ink and brush at the Talisman Table to draw and activate basic talismans.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.fire_talisman.des: Seal elemental flame within a talisman, unlocking Fire Talisman inscription and casting.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.wind_talisman.des: Capture swift wind currents in a talisman, unlocking Wind Talisman inscription and dash casting.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.seal_talisman.des: Bind movement with sealing runes, unlocking Seal Talisman inscription and casting.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.array_basics.desc: Use Spirit Stone Cores and Array Rune Stones to construct 3x3 Spirit Arrays.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.array_expansion.d: Erect Array Pillars and craft the Array Control Tablet to expand and manage formations.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.array_functions.d: Master the five operational modes of formed Spirit Arrays: Gather, Charge, Guard, Alchemy and Seal.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spirit_veins.desc: Understand underground Spirit Vein Nodes and Spirit Spring Stones.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.jade_slips.desc: Carve fine jade into Jade Slips, Jade Ward Amulets and Jade Array Plates.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.geomancy.desc: Survey terrain, water and sky alignment with a Geomantic Luopan.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.dragon_vein_seeki: Pinpoint chunk acupoints with the Dragon-Seeking Rod and unlock full Luopan sub-score readouts.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.stone_reading.des: Discern jade and strata through mountain forms and qi resonance when formal Geology is unavailable.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.divination.desc: Cast the 64 hexagrams with Divination Coins to forecast weather and receive auspicious omens.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.bone_oracle.desc: Scorch Oracle Bones at night to divine the direction and distance of distant structures.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spirit_beasts.des: Understand spirit creatures and craft Spirit Beast Seals to form lasting contracts.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spirit_farming.de: Collect Spirit Spring Bottles to enrich Spirit Soil and cultivate Spirit Herbs.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.spell_graphs.desc: Deduce custom spell graph topologies and load data-driven spell graphs.
lore.earth_xuanxue.xua.xuanxue_mastery.d: Unify inner cultivation, pill alchemy, talismans, formations and divination to unlock heirloom-grade Xuanxue creations.
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.astral_fangtian_ha: Right-click to unleash an Astral Cleave arc blocked by solid terrain.
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.spirit_spring_ston: Natural tiered Spirit Spring Stone (sizes 1-4; max size is a full block). Right-click with a bottle for spring water or stack more stones to enlarge.
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.alchemy_fur: Crafted from bronze/iron & stone after learning Pill Refining
Control Gentle/Medium/Fierce heat & redstone via the right-side control tab
Refines recovery pills, breakthrough pills, herbal remedies, and Spirit Iron Ingots
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.talisman_ta: Crafted from planks, paper, and Cinnabar Spirit Ink
Seals ambient chunk Qi into blank talisman paper so casting costs minimal mana
Produces Basic, Fire, Wind, and Seal talismans for combat & mobility
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_arra: Crafted from Spirit Stone, stone bricks & crystal shards
Works standalone as a portable array; surround with 4 Spirit Soil edges + 4 Spring/Vein corners (3x3) to form a Formal Array
Charges raw spirit stones & cores and boosts local cultivation speed
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.meditation_: Woven from wool, Spirit Grass, and Spirit Thread
Right-click to sit and meditate with full Qi efficiency and 4-stage circulation
You can also press K anytime to open the Cultivation Panel
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.array_pilla: Carved from stone bricks, Spirit Iron & crystal shards
Placed around formal arrays to channel and stabilize Qi flow
Pairs with Jade Array Plates and Control Tablets for large array grids
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_soil: Infused from dirt using Spirit Spring Bottles or Spirit Dust
Nurtures Spirit Grass & Spirit Herbs and forms the 4 edges of a 3x3 Formal Spirit Array
Foundation block for herbal farms and formal formations
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_spri: Forms naturally in sizes 1–4 (max size is a full 16x16x16 block)
Right-click with a Glass Bottle for Spirit Spring Water; right-click with another Spring Stone to grow partial blocks up to full size
Acts as a 3x3 Formal Array corner source and endless alchemy water supply
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_vein: Found in Qi-rich ridges and underground veins
Radiates dense ambient Qi; mines into Spirit Crystal Shards and Raw Spirit Stones
Top-tier corner anchor for 3x3 Formal Spirit Arrays
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.xuanhuan_ha: 泥土、任意木板或石头即可合成（合成后不消耗）
右键打开图文修行手册，随时查阅炼丹、制符、聚灵阵与境界突破脉络
新手入门必备导航工具，不会替代学识研读
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.cultivation: 以纸张、墨囊与灵尘装订
记录当前区块灵气读数、突破心得与修行阶段进度
配合学识研究台整理玄学典籍
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.qi_guiding_: 初始指引或探索聚落/合成获取
右键研读解锁「周天引气」；已学会后右键可直接唤出修行面板
踏入炼气期的第一部基础心法，开启全部后续法门
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.body_temper: 聚落交易、古迹探索或研究台编纂
研读后解锁「淬体」修行路线与主动技「护体劲」
搭配洗髓丹、淬体丹大幅提升肉身修复与抗伤
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.bigu_manual: 聚落交易或学识研究获取
研读后解锁「辟谷」路线与「养元」技，以灵气维系饱食与代谢
适合长途探索与深入地底矿脉时减少食物消耗
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.fetal_breat: 高阶研究或灵泉秘境获取
研读后解锁「胎息」路线，支持水下闭息与气息内循环
配合云息丹、闭息丹可长时间潜渊探宝
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.astral_fang: Dropped upon defeating the dual-phase Astral Sovereign boss
Left-click emits crescent Qi slashes; right-click performs 3-stage martial combos with wall-clipped hitboxes
Pinnacle melee relic of Earth: Xuanxue
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.wind_fan.ac: 以灵铁锭、羽毛与灵晶在工作台/锻造合成
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.wind_fan.me: 右键挥出巽风气浪击退并减速周围敌怪；潜行右键从脚下灵气场充能
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.wind_fan.pr: 近身被围时的极佳脱身与控场法器
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.lantern_rod: 以灵铁锭、萤石与灵化玻璃合成
右键点亮幽暗洞窟并短时标记附近生灵轮廓；潜行右键充能
地底探脉、寻矿与夜战侦察利器
以灵铁锭、深板岩与灵石合成
右键镇身赋予护体抗性并震伤近身敌人；潜行右键充能
近战硬拼与抗击打核心护身法器
以灵化玻璃与灵石核心炼制
右键短暂汇聚周围灵气转化为法力；潜行右键于高灵区块充能
野外远离聚灵阵时的便携回蓝备用源
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.luopan.acqu: 以灵铁、指南针与玉材合成
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.luopan.mech: 右键测算脚下地气品阶（1~9 阶）；习得「寻龙点穴」后显示四项分值与最近灵脉方向
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.luopan.prog: 选址建宗、寻找高阶灵脉节点与洞天福地的核心仪器
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_comp: 以红石、铁锭与灵尘合成
右键实时显示当前区块灵气等级与精确数值
新手判断何处适合打坐、摆阵与种灵草的首选工具
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.dragon_seek: 以灵铁胚、铜锭与灵晶合成
右键感应周边地下灵脉与矿脉走向，发出定向共鸣粒子
配合罗盘快速定位地下灵脉节点
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.divination_: 右键掷钱起卦，依卦象获得短时吉兆状态（制符不耗笔耐久、炼丹提纯）
重要炼丹、破境或挑战 BOSS 前占卜增运
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.oracle_bone: 探索古迹或由骨头经灵气祭炼获得
夜间副手持打火石右键灼骨观裂，指向百区块内最近古迹或修行聚落
快速定位野外修行聚落、坊市与秘境遗迹
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.spirit_beas: 以灵丝、玉材与朱砂灵墨合成
先喂食灵草将野生灵兽亲和度提升至 3，再手持契印右键缔结主仆契约
契约灵狐、风狼、赤焰鹤、石角羊、晶甲龟并肩作战
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.jade_slip.m: 可作高阶学识载体（研读耗时直接减半），亦可储藏 48 AEU 灵气
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.jade_slip.p: 研究台抄录、传授高阶功法与跨学科典籍的最佳介质
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.jade_array_: 由硬玉与灵晶精雕而成
对聚灵阵核心右键绑定，可扩展阵法扫描与聚灵半径（+1~2 格）
大型宗门聚灵阵与多设施联动必备配件
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.jade_ward_a: 右键消耗内部玉灵储量，立即赋予护体抗性与伤害吸收护盾
探索险地与 BOSS 战中的瞬发保命护符
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.array_contr: 由石板、灵铁与阵纹石合成
绑定多座聚灵阵与阵柱，统一查看阵网灵气负载并远程切换阵法模式
后期自动化灵气工厂与大型宗门阵法核心
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.array_rune_: 在符案或工作台刻录灵纹而成
嵌入阵柱或合成高阶阵盘，定向赋予聚灵、防护或加速效果
定制化阵法功能模块的基础组件
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.talisman_br: 以木棍、灵丝与灵草制成
置于符案作为制符工具，耐久 64 点，每次成符消耗 1 点（吉兆时不耗）
批量绘制各类灵符的必需工具
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.talisman_pa: 放入符案配合朱砂灵墨即可封入环境灵气，绘成可激发灵符
所有攻击、身法与控制符箓的基础耗材
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.empty_talis: 尚未注入灵气与符纹的空白符胚，需经符案加持后方能生效
符道学徒练习与合成基础符的前置材料
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.basic_talis: 于符案消耗符纸与朱砂灵墨绘成
右键耗少量法力激发纯净灵气弹，打击中近距离敌怪
前期低成本远程自保消耗品
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.fire_talism: 于符案配烈焰/火系触媒绘成
右键消耗法力掷出离火符焰，点燃并灼伤前方目标
对付成群亡灵、寒霜生物与森林妖兽效果拔群
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.wind_talism: 于符案配羽毛/风系触媒绘成
右键仅耗 1 点法力向前疾掠 6 格，瞬间拉近或脱离战圈
躲避镇岳星君天罚砸地与穿山越岭的神级位移符
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.seal_talism: 于符案配灵尘/控场触媒绘成
右键消耗 3 点法力施加定身迟滞灵环，大幅压制前方目标移速
限制高机动敌怪、风狼或失控修士走位
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.qi_recovery: 于丹炉以灵草 + 灵泉瓶炼成
右键服用立即恢复法力；与打坐不同，完全不消耗脚下区块灵气
战斗与高耗法力施法时的主力续航丹药
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.foundation_: 于丹炉高阶配方炼制（需筑基丹方）
炼气圆满后服用，显著提高突破至「筑基期」的成功率与稳固度
前期向中阶修士跃迁的关键里程碑丹药
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.breakthroug: 于丹炉配灵晶与高阶灵药炼制
在金丹、元婴等高阶瓶颈期服用，平抑冲关反噬并助推破境
冲击高阶境界与挑战镇岳星君前的必带丹药
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.marrow_pill: 于丹炉配矿质与灵药炼成（需已习淬体诀）
服用后直接增加 +120 炼体修为，伐毛洗髓强化体魄
快速提升炼体等级与「护体劲」持续时间
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.ironbody_pi: 于丹炉以灵铁粉/矿材催化炼制
服用后短时大幅提升护甲抗性与伤害吸收护盾
硬抗 BOSS 爆发或下矿遭遇精英怪前服用
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.grainfast_p: 于丹炉以灵草与谷物合炼
长时间压制饥饿消耗并稳步推进辟谷修为
高强度长途探险与地下开采续航首选
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.fast_pill.m: 轻量缓解饥饿感并微量补益灵气
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.fast_pill.p: 辟谷丹的平价日常替代品
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.nightsight_: 于丹炉以灵草配金胡萝卜炼制
赋予清晰夜视视野并小幅提升移动速度
暗洞寻脉、夜袭古迹与深渊探索必备
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.cloudbreath: 于丹炉以灵泉与青草炼制
大幅延长水下闭息并轻身缓落
深海灵泉采掘与高空建筑作业良药
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.breath_pill: 短时补满氧气并稳住呼吸节奏
配合胎息诀前期水下探索使用
于丹炉以甘草类灵植炼制
立即清除中毒等负面状态，保护气血稳定
遭遇洞穴蜘蛛、女巫与毒沼时的常备救命丹
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.resolve_tox: 本草丹方：甘草、绿豆配灵泉于丹炉精炼
清除中毒并赋予 300 刻中毒免疫，品阶越高持续越佳
高难秘境与长期抗毒作战的进阶解毒丹
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.calm_spirit: 本草丹方配灵泉慢火温炼
平复心神、驱散反胃/失明等精神干扰并稳定法力回复
冲关前稳定心境或解除控场减益
tooltip.earth_xuanxue.detail.clear_heat_: 本草丹方配清凉灵泉炼制
